# truefoundry_prompt (Resource)

Manages a prompt (`chat_prompt` manifest) via `PUT /api/svc/v1/prompt-versions` — a versioned message template in an ML repo (`truefoundry_ml_repo`). Every update creates a new immutable prompt version on the control plane. The advanced manifest blocks (tools, MCP servers, guardrails, response format, routing, caching, sub-agents) are not supported and are dropped from the new version when a prompt is updated with this resource. Existing prompts can be imported by their name, e.g. `terraform import truefoundry_prompt.example my-prompt`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A prompt is a versioned message template in an ML repo, usable via the
# gateway and the TrueFoundry SDKs.
resource "truefoundry_prompt" "ticket_triage" {
  name          = "ticket-triage"
  ml_repo       = truefoundry_ml_repo.gateway_artifacts.name
  description   = "Classifies inbound support tickets"
  version_alias = "v1.0.0"

  messages = [
    {
      role    = "system"
      content = "You triage support tickets for the {{product}} team."
    },
    {
      role    = "user"
      content = "Ticket: {{ticket}}"
    },
  ]

  variables = {
    product = "app"
    ticket  = ""
  }

  model_configuration = {
    provider = "my-openai-account"
    model    = "gpt-5-mini"
    parameters = {
      max_tokens  = 2048
      temperature = 0.1
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `messages` (Attributes List) The message template, in order. Message contents may reference variables as {{name}}. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messages))
- `ml_repo` (String) Name of the ML repo the prompt lives in. It must exist on the tenant. Changing it replaces the prompt.
- `name` (String) Name of the prompt (lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens). Changing it replaces the prompt.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of what the prompt is for.
- `model_configuration` (Attributes) The gateway model the prompt is bound to. Omitted means callers pick the model themselves. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model_configuration))
- `variables` (Map of String) Template variables usable in message contents as {{name}}, mapped to their default values.
- `version_alias` (String) Alias for the prompt version created by this apply, e.g. v1.0.0.

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the prompt, e.g. chat_prompt:my-tenant/my-repo/my-prompt. A specific version is referenced by appending its number, e.g. `"${truefoundry_prompt.example.fqn}:1"`.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the prompt.

<a id="nestedatt--messages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `messages`

Required:

- `content` (String) Text content of the message.
- `role` (String) Role of the message: `system`, `developer`, `user`, or `assistant`.

Optional:

- `name` (String) Optional participant name to disambiguate multiple participants with the same role.


<a id="nestedatt--model_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model_configuration`

Required:

- `model` (String) Model name within the provider account, e.g. gpt-5-mini.
- `provider` (String) Gateway provider account name, e.g. my-account.

Optional:

- `extra_parameters` (String) Provider-specific extra parameters as a JSON object string, e.g. via jsonencode().
- `parameters` (Attributes) Inference parameters passed to the model. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model_configuration--parameters))

<a id="nestedatt--model_configuration--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model_configuration.parameters`

Optional:

- `max_tokens` (Number) Maximum number of tokens the model may generate.
- `stop` (List of String) Sequences at which the model stops generating.
- `temperature` (Number) Sampling temperature.
- `top_k` (Number) Top-k sampling cutoff.
- `top_p` (Number) Nucleus sampling probability mass.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Prompts are imported by their name.
terraform import truefoundry_prompt.ticket_triage ticket-triage
```
